name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with wrists straight.
Unrack the bar and pull shoulder blades back and down into the bench.
Lower bar with control to lower-mid sternum, elbows angled ~45 degrees.
Press explosively back up to lockout without flaring elbows.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline.
Kick dumbbells to chest as you lie back.
Press dumbbells overhead without clinking them together at the top.
Lower under control until elbows are slightly below chest level.
commonMistakes: Incline too steep (>45 degrees becomes shoulder press)

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30 degree incline.
Lower bar to upper chest clavicle region.
Press upward locking out over eye line.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench with dumbbells over chest.
Lower dumbbells with a deep stretch at bottom.
Press upward converging gently at top.

name: Chest Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars and jump to top support.
Lean torso forward 30 degrees to bias lower chest.
Lower until shoulders are below elbows.
Press back up while maintaining forward lean.
commonMistakes: Staying completely upright (shifts tension to triceps)

name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set cable pulleys above head height with D-handles.
Take a small step forward into staggered stance.
Bring hands downward and together in an arcing hugging motion.
Pause and squeeze lower chest peak contraction.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: Set pulleys to bottom floor level.
Pull upward and inward toward upper chest.
Hold contraction at eye level.

name: Machine Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest.
Keep elbows softly bent and shoulders retracted.
Bring handles together and squeeze pecs hard for 1 second.
Return slowly to a deep comfortable stretch.

name: Standard Push-Up
instructions: Plank position with hands slightly outside shoulders.
Brace glutes and abs in straight line.
Lower chest until 1 inch from floor.
Push floor away to full protraction.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place feet on bench or elevated surface, hands on floor.
Lower chest to ground emphasizing clavicular head.
Press upward to top plank.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit with back firmly against pad.
Grip handles at mid-chest height.
Press forward to full extension without locking elbows violently.
Resist on the eccentric phase.

name: Flat Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on flat bench holding dumbbells with neutral grip.
Lower weights in wide arc maintaining slight bend at elbows.
Feel deep chest stretch, then contract pecs to return.
coachingCues: Slight elbow bend locked in place
Stop when elbows align with bench

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Set bench to 30 degree incline.
Open arms in wide arc until deep chest stretch.
Bring dumbbells together over upper chest.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lock shins under decline bench pads.
Unrack bar and lower with control to lower chest.
Press upward vertically.
commonMistakes: Head rushing with blood (avoid holding breath)

name: Standing Landmine Press
instructions: Hold tip of landmine barbell at shoulder.
Press upward at 45 degree angle with full reach.
Lower under control to clavicle.
coachingCues: Reach at top to engage serratus

name: Standing Cable Chest Press
instructions: Step forward between cable pulleys at chest height.
Press handles together forward in straight line.
Slowly allow handles back for full stretch.

name: Plate Pinch Svend Press
instructions: Pinch two 5kg plates together between flat palms at chest.
Extend arms straight out while squeezing plates together hard.
Bring back to chest maintaining inward pressure.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
instructions: Align incline bench so bar touches upper chest.
Unrack hooks with wrist rotation.
Lower to 1 inch above chest, press forcefully.
coachingCues: Fixed track allows max chest isolation
commonMistakes: Positioning bench too far back or forward

name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under barbell, feet hip-width.
Hinge hips back and grip bar just outside knees.
Pull chest up, engage lats like putting shoulder blades in back pockets.
Drive floor away through heels, locking hips and knees together at top.
Hinge back down with bar skimming thighs.
commonMistakes: Squatting the weight instead of hinging

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Step inside hex bar, feet hip-width.
Grip neutral handles, chest tall.
Drive upward standing tall.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge torso forward to ~45 degrees with flat back.
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull bar to lower sternum/belly button driving elbows back.
Lower with control feeling lats stretch.

name: Bodyweight Pull-Up
instructions: Hang with overhand grip wider than shoulders.
Depress scapulae and pull chest toward bar.
Chin clears bar at top.
Lower all the way to dead hang.

name: Bodyweight Chin-Up
instructions: Underhand supinated grip shoulder width.
Pull chest up until chin clears bar.
Lower with control to full extension.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Lock thighs under pads on machine.
Grip wide bar on outer angles.
Lean back slightly and pull bar to upper chest.
Return with control letting lats stretch upward.

name: Close-Grip V-Bar Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach V-bar handle to pulldown cable.
Pull straight down to upper chest, elbows tucked.
Squeeze lower lats at bottom.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: One knee and hand on flat bench, back parallel to floor.
Hang dumbbell in opposite arm with neutral grip.
Row dumbbell up toward hip crease.
Lower under control to full lat stretch.
commonMistakes: Pulling dumbbell to shoulder instead of hip

name: Seated Cable Row (Neutral Grip)
instructions: Sit with knees slightly bent, feet on footplates.
Grip double-D handle, back upright.
Pull handle to navel driving elbows back and pinching scapulae.
Extend arms fully feeling stretch.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
instructions: Lie face down on pad with chest supported.
Grip handles and pull elbows high and back.
Squeeze rhomboids and middle traps at top.

name: Chest-Supported Incline Dumbbell Row
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline, lie chest down.
Row dumbbells up with flared elbows (~60 deg) for upper back.
Lower with full stretch.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing high cable with straight bar or rope.
Keep arms straight with tiny elbow bend.
Push bar down in arc toward thighs using lats.
Squeeze lats at bottom and control back up.
coachingCues: Think about pushing down, not pulling
commonMistakes: Bending elbows turning into triceps pushdown

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie perpendicular across bench supporting upper back.
Hold dumbbell with both hands diamond grip over chest.
Lower dumbbell back over head in arc until deep lat stretch.
Pull back over chest using lats.

name: Landmine Meadows Row
instructions: Stand perpendicular to landmine bar.
Overhand grip on thick collar of barbell.
Row elbow up and back flared out.

name: Incline Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Lie face down on 45 degree incline bench holding dumbbells.
Shrug shoulder blades upward and backward toward ears.
Hold 1 second contraction at top.

name: Standing Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell in front of thighs shoulder-width.
Elevate shoulders straight up toward ears.
Pause 1 sec at top and lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides.
Elevate shoulders vertically.
Hold peak squeeze.

name: Back Extension (Hyperextension)
instructions: Position hips on 45-degree hyperextension bench.
Cross arms or hold plate at chest.
Lower torso down hinging at hips, then extend back to neutral spine.
commonMistakes: Violent arching at top of rep

name: Barbell Good Morning
instructions: Barbell across upper back as in a squat.
Soft bend in knees, hinge hips back until torso reaches ~60 degrees.
Drive hips forward to return to standing.
coachingCues: Feel deep hamstring and erector tension
Back stays flat as a table

name: Inverted Bodyweight Row
instructions: Hang underneath bar racked at waist height, heels on floor.
Pull chest up to touch bar keeping body rigid as a plank.
Lower slowly.

name: Barbell Overhead Press (OHP)
instructions: Bar on collarbones, press straight overhead locking out over crown.
coachingCues: Pull head back then push through window

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Press dumbbells from ear height to overhead lockout.
coachingCues: Keep elbows slightly forward of body line

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells out to sides until parallel with floor, pinkies slightly elevated.
coachingCues: Pour out a pitcher of water
commonMistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging hips

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set pulley to hip height, raise across body to shoulder level.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Attach rope to eye level, pull handles toward ears while rotating thumbs back.
coachingCues: Double bicep flex pose at end

name: Machine Reverse Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit chest to pad, pull handles back horizontally focusing on posterior delts.
commonMistakes: Pinching traps instead of isolating rear delts

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward, raise dumbbells out to sides.

name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
instructions: Start palms facing you at chest, rotate outward as you press overhead.

name: Barbell Front Raise
instructions: Raise bar forward to shoulder height with straight arms.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise (Alternating)
instructions: Raise dumbbell forward alternating hands.

name: Lu Xiaojun Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells all the way overhead in circular arc.

name: Machine Overhead Press
instructions: Press handles overhead with back firmly supported.

name: Cable Upright Row
instructions: Pull cable bar up along chest with wide grip.

name: Smith Behind-the-Neck Press
instructions: Lower bar to ear level behind head on Smith track.

name: Wall Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Handstand against wall, lower head to mat, press up.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Feet on floor, hips pushed high in V-shape, press head toward floor.

name: Cable Y-Raise
instructions: Cross cables, raise arms up and out in Y formation.
coachingCues: Focus on lower traps and side delts

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly (Cross-Over)
instructions: Cross cables without handles, pull outward at eye height.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper traps, feet shoulder-width, squat down until hip crease breaks knee line.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Clean grip or cross-arm rack bar across front deltoids, squat with upright torso.

name: 45-Degree Leg Press
instructions: Sit in sled, place feet mid-plate, lower sled to 90 degree knee bend, press back up.
commonMistakes: Butt curling off pad at bottom

name: Machine Hack Squat
instructions: Shoulders under pads, feet low and narrow on platform for max quad isolation.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench, squat down on lead leg until back knee touches floor.
coachingCues: Drop straight down like an elevator
commonMistakes: Front foot placed too close to bench

name: Dumbbell / Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell vertically against chest, squat deep between knees.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into deep lunge, drive off front heel to step into next lunge.

name: Leg Extension Machine
instructions: Sit with pad against lower shins, extend knees to full contraction.

name: Bodyweight Sissy Squat
instructions: Lean torso back as knees travel forward over toes.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Hold bar at thighs, push hips back with soft knees until deep hamstring stretch.
coachingCues: Push hips to the back wall

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells against thighs, hinge hips back until hamstrings are taut.
commonMistakes: Lowering dumbbells too far past mid-shin

name: Lying Hamstring Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down, pad above heels, curl heels to glutes.
coachingCues: Keep hips pressed down into pad
commonMistakes: Hips lifting off bench to cheat

name: Seated Hamstring Leg Curl
instructions: Thigh pad secure, curl heels under seat.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, barbell cushioned over hip crease, drive hips to ceiling.
commonMistakes: Arching lower back instead of hip extension

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Back on floor or bench, dumbbell on hips, drive hips up.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Ankle strap attached, kick leg backward squeezing glute.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Balls of feet on block, lower heels into deep stretch, press high on big toes.

name: Seated Calf Raise (Soleus Focus)
instructions: Sit with pad on thighs, full ankle range of motion.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Hinge at waist, weight on lower back/hips, raise up on toes.

name: Seated Hip Adductor Machine
instructions: Squeeze thighs together against pads, slow eccentric.

name: Seated Hip Abductor Machine
instructions: Press thighs outward against outer pads.
coachingCues: Lean slightly forward for upper glute recruitment

name: Sumo Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Wide stance, toes pointed out, hands inside knees, press floor away.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Wide stance, hold dumbbell between legs, squat deep.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Ankles anchored, lower torso slowly toward floor resisting with hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Box Step-Up
instructions: Step onto box, drive through lead heel without jumping off rear foot.

name: Standing Barbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Shoulder-width underhand grip, curl bar to collarbones keeping elbows locked at sides.
commonMistakes: Swinging torso back to initiate rep

name: EZ-Bar Bicep Curl
instructions: Hold angled grips on EZ bar, curl upward with joint comfort.

name: Standing Dumbbell Curl (Supinating)
instructions: Curl dumbbells rotating pinky up at top of movement.
coachingCues: Full supination for max peak contraction

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on 45-60 degree incline, arms hanging straight down for extreme bicep stretch.
coachingCues: Feel deep bicep stretch at bottom

name: Neutral-Grip Hammer Curl
instructions: Palms facing inward neutral grip, curl dumbbells up targeting brachialis and brachioradialis.

name: Preacher Bench Curl (Machine or Barbell)
instructions: Arms over angled preacher pad, curl up without lifting armpits off pad.

name: Seated Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on bench, elbow braced inside thigh, curl dumbbell up to chin.

name: Straight-Bar Cable Curl
instructions: Low pulley cable curl with constant tension at peak.

name: Rope Cable Hammer Curl
instructions: Low cable with rope, pull upward splitting rope at top.

name: Prone Incline Spider Curl
instructions: Lie chest down on steep incline, curl bar hanging straight down.

name: Cable Tricep Rope Pushdown
instructions: High pulley with rope, push down extending elbows and spreading rope at bottom.
commonMistakes: Elbows drifting up and down like wings

name: Cable Tricep Straight-Bar Pushdown
instructions: Overhand grip on bar, press down to full tricep lockout.

name: Barbell / EZ-Bar Skull Crusher (Lying Extension)
instructions: Lie on bench, arms vertical over chest, bend elbows lowering bar to forehead/crown.
coachingCues: Keep upper arms angled back slightly

name: Seated Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbell overhead with two hands, lower behind head for deep long-head stretch.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension (Rope)
instructions: Turn away from cable, extend rope forward and overhead.
coachingCues: Constant stretch and tension on long head

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart (not too close), lower to lower chest and press.
commonMistakes: Hands too close together (<6 inches causes wrist pain)

name: Tricep Parallel Bar Dips
instructions: Stay upright with torso vertical, lower until elbows are at 90 degrees and push.

name: Single-Arm Cable Tricep Kickback
instructions: Bend forward, upper arm parallel to floor, extend forearm back straight.

name: Seated Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearms rested on thighs, curl wrists upward.

name: Seated Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Overhand grip, extend wrists upward.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar, curl hips and raise toes to bar without swinging.
coachingCues: Do not rely on hip flexors alone

name: Hanging Knee Raise (Beginner)
instructions: Hang from bar, bring knees to chest, lower slowly.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing cable stack holding rope at forehead, crunch ribcage down toward pelvis.
commonMistakes: Sitting back on heels instead of crunching

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel with wheel under shoulders, roll forward keeping hollow-body posterior tilt.
coachingCues: Do not let lower back sag

name: Standard Forearm Plank
instructions: Forearms and toes on floor, body in completely rigid straight line.
coachingCues: Squeeze glutes and abs like taking a punch
commonMistakes: Hips piking in air or sagging down

name: Side Plank
instructions: Hold body straight on one forearm and side of foot.
coachingCues: Straight line from ear to ankle

name: Cable Pallof Press
instructions: Stand perpendicular to cable, press handle straight out from chest resisting rotation.

name: Russian Twist (Weighted)
instructions: Sit with feet elevated, rotate plate or dumbbell side to side.

name: Cable Woodchopper (Diagonal)
instructions: High to low or low to high rotational chop across body.

name: Decline Bench Sit-Up
instructions: Hook feet in decline bench, curl up to top.
coachingCues: Round spine on way up and down

name: Captain's Chair Knee/Leg Raise
instructions: Forearms on pads, raise legs upward.

name: Stomach Vacuum
instructions: Exhale all air, pull belly button toward spine and hold.
coachingCues: Target transverse abdominis for a tighter waist

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back, lower opposite arm and leg while pressing lower back into floor.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Hands and knees, reach opposite arm and leg straight out.
coachingCues: Keep hips level like holding a glass of water

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on back, press lumbar spine into floor, hover legs and arms 6 inches off ground.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on back, rotate elbow to opposite knee alternating smoothly.
coachingCues: Shoulder to knee, not just elbow

name: Barbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor, lower bar until triceps touch floor softly, press up.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Floor press with dumbbells, pausing at bottom.

name: Cable Iron Cross
instructions: High cables pulled down into horizontal T position holding isometric.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Hands touch forming diamond under sternum, push up.

name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Hands placed 1.5x shoulder width, push up.

name: Archer Push-Up
instructions: Lower toward one arm while extending other arm straight out to side.

name: Neck Press (Guillotine Bench)
instructions: Wide grip, lower bar to neck/upper chest with light weight.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Press dumbbells on decline bench with neutral or pronated grip.

name: Heavy Kroc Dumbbell Row
instructions: Heavy single arm row with controlled body English for high reps.

name: Plank Renegade Row
instructions: In pushup plank on dumbbells, row one dumbbell to hip without rotating pelvis.

name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
instructions: Hinge over two kettlebells on floor, row one while pressing other down.

name: Seal Row (Elevated Bench Barbell Row)
instructions: Lie face down on elevated high bench, row barbell up to bench underside.

name: Barbell Rack Pull (Above Knee)
instructions: Bar on pins just below or above knees, pull to lockout.

name: Pendlay Barbell Row (From Floor)
instructions: Torso strictly parallel to floor, explode bar off floor to sternum every rep.
coachingCues: Dead stop on floor every rep

name: Underhand Yates Row
instructions: Torso at 70 degrees, underhand grip, row into belly.

name: Seated Cable Face Pull to Neck
instructions: Seated cable pull to eye line with external shoulder rotation.
commonMistakes: Pulling to chin instead of forehead

name: Zercher Barbell Squat
instructions: Bar held in crooks of elbows against chest, squat deep.
coachingCues: Massive core and upper back tension

name: Cossack Squat (Lateral Squat)
instructions: Wide stance, shift all weight to one side squatting deep while opposite leg stays straight.

name: Curtsey Lunge
instructions: Step foot diagonally behind and across front leg, lower into lunge.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell RDL
instructions: Hinge forward on one leg while trailing leg floats straight back parallel to floor.

name: Wall Tibialis Raise
instructions: Back against wall, heels 12 inches out, pull toes up toward shins.

name: Machine Belt Squat
instructions: Weight attached to dip belt at hips, squat without any spinal compression.
coachingCues: Pure quad drive with 0 spine loading

name: Glute-Ham Developer Raise (GHD)
instructions: On GHD bench, lower torso and pull back up by flexing hamstrings.

name: Barbell Box Squat
instructions: Squat back onto box, pause momentarily without relaxing core, explode up.
coachingCues: Sit back, shins vertical, drive up
commonMistakes: Rocking off box to cheat momentum

name: Glute Frog Pumps
instructions: Lie on back, soles of feet together like butterfly, pump hips up.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Torso on bench, swing legs up behind using glutes and erectors.

name: Bayesian Cable Bicep Curl
instructions: Face away from low cable, arm behind torso, curl forward for long head stretch.
coachingCues: Max stretch on long head of bicep

name: Cross-Body Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbell across torso toward opposite shoulder.

name: JM Press
instructions: Hybrid close-grip bench and skull crusher lowering bar to throat/chin.
coachingCues: Elbows at 45 deg, powerful tricep mass builder

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench, dumbbells touch at chest, point elbows out and extend forearms.

name: Weight Plate Bus Driver
instructions: Hold 10-15kg plate at eye level, rotate steering wheel left and right.

name: Heavy Dumbbell Farmer Walk
instructions: Pick up two heavy dumbbells, walk tall with short controlled steps.
coachingCues: Crush grip, proud chest, zero sway

name: Plyometric Box Jump
instructions: Stand before box, swing arms, jump and land softly with bent knees on top of box.

name: Bodyweight Squat Jump
instructions: Quarter squat down, explode vertically into jump, absorb landing softly.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: High plank, drive knees forward toward chest in rhythmic cadence.

name: Russian Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge hips back holding kettlebell, snap hips forward driving bell to chest height.
coachingCues: Hip snap, not a shoulder front raise

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie holding kettlebell locked overhead, stand up step-by-step maintaining vertical arm.
coachingCues: Eyes on kettlebell at all times
